brief.headline: Cut Dextrose price by 13.6% to match Sayaji Industries — we're overpaying ₹14.26 L/yr for the same material

priceAsk.summary: Drop Dextrose to ₹66.48/KG, the price we already pay Sayaji Industries for identical material
priceAsk.basis: We pay them ₹75.51/KG today — that's 13.6% more than Sayaji's ₹66.48/KG for the same Dextrose Anhydrous IP. Market asking prices for this item run ₹60–81/kg (typically ₹66–73/kg), so ₹66.48/KG sits right in the fair market band and is already proven in our supply chain.

paymentTermAsk.summary: Keep 30 Days After Receipt — no change needed

brief.financialLeverage: They're big — ₹556.14 Cr in sales — and we're tiny at ₹59.65 L (just 0.11% of their business), so on our own we don't move the needle for them. But they're growing fast (42.6% a year), which means they want new orders to keep that momentum. They keep about ₹3.50 of every ₹100 they sell (3.5% margin) and carry debt of 0.41x equity, so they're not desperate but every order counts. The play here is to dangle a multi-year volume commitment or threaten to shift the whole ₹59.65 L to Sayaji — either way, tie more volume to the lower price.

evidence.point: We overpay by 13.6% versus the best price in our own books
evidence.figure: ₹75.51/KG vs ₹66.48/KG (Sayaji), gap 13.6%, costing us ₹14.26 L/yr extra

evidence.point: Market asking prices confirm ₹66.48/KG is fair
evidence.figure: Anhydrous Dextrose IP market band ₹60–81/kg, typical ₹66–73/kg — verdict MARKET-FAIR

evidence.point: They're growing revenue very fast and want volume
We're a tiny customer with no individual leverage
evidence.figure: ₹59.65 L spend = 0.11% of their ₹556.14 Cr revenue

evidence.point: They keep only a small slice of every sale as profit
India export benchmark for Dextrose is well below our current price
evidence.figure: India export unit value 42.95 ₹/kg vs our ₹75.51/KG

alternates.name: Sayaji Industries Limited
alternates.why: Already our supplier at ₹66.48/KG — proven quality, proven price, ready to take more volume today

alternates.name: Gulshan Polyols Ltd
alternates.why: Listed starch maker, ₹2359.06 Cr revenue, health score B (62/100) — established dextrose supplier, drop-in alternate

alternates.name: Sanstar Ltd
alternates.why: Recently-listed maize-derivatives specialist, ₹842.97 Cr revenue, health C (52/100) — growing capacity in dextrose

risks: We're only 0.11% of their sales — they can easily say no unless we commit more volume or a longer term in exchange for the price cut.
Their profit is thin (3.5% margin) so a 13.6% price cut wipes out almost four years of margin on our business — be ready for them to ask for a volume guarantee or to walk.
If we push too hard and they refuse, we need Sayaji ready to absorb the ₹59.65 L immediately — confirm their capacity before this meeting.
Market asking prices show a wide band (₹60–81/kg), so they may argue ₹75.51/KG is still 'in range' — counter with the typical band (₹66–73/kg) and our proven ₹66.48/KG with Sayaji.
brief.suggestedOpeningLine: We want to grow our Dextrose volume with you, but today we're paying ₹75.51/KG here versus ₹66.48/KG at Sayaji — let's close that 13.6% gap and talk about a longer commitment.
